Persita Tangerang vs Malut United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 13th round of the Indonesian Liga 1, where Persita Tangerang hosts the ambitious top-flight newcomer, Malut United, at their Indomilk Arena. This is a clash between two teams fighting for survival and looking to improve their league positions.

Kick-off: November 23, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Indomilk Arena, Tangerang Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persita Tangerang vs Malut United: Match Preview

Both teams approach this head-to-head meeting from the lower part of the league table. Persita is an experienced Liga 1 contender but has shown inconsistent results this season. Malut United, a top-flight debutant, is finding it difficult to adapt to the realities of the top division after their promotion from Liga 2. This will be the first-ever official meeting between the clubs in the Super League, which adds extra intrigue. For both teams, this is a 'six-pointer.'

Team Form and Analysis

Persita Tangerang

The 'Cisadane Warriors' are going through a tough time. The team has shown poor performance and is struggling with goal-scoring. At home, Persita will be looking to end their run of poor results and secure a crucial three points against a direct competitor. The head coach will be counting on the experience of his leaders, such as Argentine forward Ramiro Fergonzi and team captain Muhammad Toha.

Malut United

The 'Laskar Kie Raha Eagles' will be highly motivated to prove they are worthy of playing in the top flight. The team relies on an organized defense and set pieces. Despite their newcomer status, Malut United has already caused problems for several strong opponents. The team's squad features a group of experienced Indonesian players, as well as foreign imports brought in to strengthen the team in the top division.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persita (4-2-3-1): Kuniawan; Toha, Guseynov, Chariton, Jardim; Bachna, Sinsook; Vidal, Fergonzi, Sahrul; Altindig.
  • Malut United (4-3-3): Ady; Bagab, Manahati, Cardoso, Fretyan; Pramana, Hariadi, Al-Ayyubi; Rifaldi, José, Puhiri.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two evenly matched underdogs is extremely difficult to predict. Persita has the home-field advantage and more experience in the top flight. Malut United, however, is a 'dark horse.'

  • Main Prediction: Persita to Win or Draw (1X). Playing at home against a direct rival for survival, the 'Cisadane Warriors' will give their all to at least avoid defeat against the league newcomer.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams with problems in attack, where the cost of a mistake is very high. A six-pointer match is likely to be cautious and not very high-scoring.

Welcome to the live broadcast of a crucial match in the 16th round of the Russian Premier League, where Krylya Sovetov Samara hosts FC Rostov. This is a clash between two direct competitors in the relegation battle, both desperately needing points to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: November 22, 2025, 11:00 UTC (14:00 MSK) Stadium: Solidarnost Samara Arena, Samara Competition: Russian Premier League

Krylya Sovetov vs Rostov: Match Preview

The teams approach this head-to-head meeting in close proximity in the league table. Krylya Sovetov is in 13th place with 11 points, while Rostov is one spot below, with 10 points. Both teams have been showing inconsistent results. Krylya is winless in their last ten league matches, suffering seven defeats. Rostov, in contrast, secured an important away victory against Akron in the last round, ending their winless streak. The head-to-head history favors Rostov, who have won 4 of the last 6 encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Krylya Sovetov

The 'Krylja,' under Igor Osinkin, rely on a compact defense and fast counter-attacks. At home, with the support of their fans, the team will try to impose a gritty fight and capitalize on their chances. However, the team's main problem is their weak attack, as they score few goals.

Rostov

The 'Yellow-Blues,' under Valery Karpin, are showing inconsistent results but are capable of causing surprises. The team relies on high pressing and speed. The team's leader in attack is Egor Golenkov, who scored in the last round. Rostov will aim to break their run of poor form and climb out of the relegation zone.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Krylya Sovetov (4-2-3-1): Lomaev; Rasskazov, Gorbunov, Soldatenkov, Gorshkov; Vityug, Gaponov, Ignatenkov; Kylin, Garré, Kajhojin.
  • Rostov (4-2-3-1): Pesyakov; Vakhaniya, Osipenko, Komlichenko, El-Ascalany; Glebov, Utkin; Bayramyan, Komarov, Mohebbi; Golenkov.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two evenly matched teams in different form, and close in the table, is extremely difficult to predict. Orenburg has the home-field advantage, but Rostov is in better current form.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. Given the relatively equal class of the teams, their current form, and the importance of the match, a draw seems the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams that focus on defense and struggle in attack. 4 of the last 6 head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring. A tight contest with a small number of goals is expected.

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the key battles for survival in the Italian Serie A. At the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi, Hellas Verona hosts Parma in a true six-pointer between two teams aiming to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: November 23, 2025, 11:30 UTC (14:30 MSK) Stadium: Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi, Verona Competition: Serie A

Hellas Verona vs Parma: Match Preview

Both teams come into this head-to-head meeting from the lower part of the league table. Both Verona and Parma are struggling this season and are in desperate need of points. Verona is traditionally resilient at home, where, with the support of their fans, they are capable of challenging any opponent. Parma, on the other hand, has struggled in away games. The head-to-head history shows a slight advantage for Verona, who have won three of the last five encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Hellas Verona

The 'Mastiffs' build their game on physical battles, commitment, and set pieces. The team's main task will be to secure three points against a direct competitor to pull away from the relegation zone. At home, Verona will try to play on the front foot and apply pressure.

Parma

The 'Crusaders' are experiencing serious problems in attack, being one of the least productive teams in the league. It will be extremely difficult for the visitors to hope for a positive result in an away match against a resilient Verona. The team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy, hoping for chances on the counter-attack.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The outcome of a duel between two direct competitors for survival is extremely difficult to predict. Verona has the home-field advantage and a more successful head-to-head history.

  • Main Prediction: Verona to Win. Playing at home against a direct competitor with obvious problems in attack, the 'Mastiffs' must seize their chance and take a crucial three points.

Bali United vs Persis Solo: Match Preview

Pari NN vs Zenit: Match Preview

The teams approach this match from opposite ends of the league table. Zenit is confidently among the leaders and is competing for another gold medal. Pari NN, on the other hand, is in the lower half of the table and is in a desperate fight for survival. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the St. Petersburg side, with Zenit having won all six previous encounters with a combined score of 16-2.

Team Form and Analysis

Pari NN

Saša Ilić's team relies on a pragmatic style of football and solid defensive play. At home, the Nizhny Novgorod side is traditionally tough to beat and capable of challenging any opponent. However, the team's main problem is their lack of goals - Pari NN is one of the lowest-scoring teams in the league. Against the best attack in the RPL, the hosts are likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Zenit

Sergei Semak's team has hit its stride and is looking to strengthen its lead. Zenit has been phenomenally prolific and boasts the most solid defense in the league. The visitors will dominate the match and will be looking to secure another three points to keep their competitors at bay.

Zenit is the undisputed favorite for this match. The difference in class, current form, and head-to-head statistics make a victory for the St. Petersburg club the most likely outcome. It will be extremely difficult for the Nizhny Novgorod side to offer any resistance to Sergei Semak's machine.

Real Oviedo vs Rayo Vallecano: Match Preview

Both teams approach this match from the middle of the table, showing inconsistent results. Real Oviedo, having triumphantly returned to La Liga, is particularly resilient at home, where they regularly pick up points with the support of their fans. Rayo Vallecano, in turn, is a solid mid-table team known for its bold and attacking style of play but struggles in away matches. The head-to-head history between these teams, mostly from the Segunda División, is marked by a tight contest with no clear favorite.

Team Form and Analysis

Real Oviedo

For the Asturian club, this season is a true celebration. The team, led by the experience of the legendary Santi Cazorla, will focus on an organized defense and set pieces. At home, Oviedo will be highly motivated to challenge and take three important points against a direct competitor.

Rayo Vallecano

The 'Red Sashes,' under Iñigo Pérez, remain true to their attacking style. The team presses high and tries to play on the front foot even away from home. However, this tactic often leads to defensive problems. In attack, all hopes are on the experienced striker Raúl de Tomás and the creativity of Isi Palazón.

Cremonese vs Roma: Match Preview

Roma comes into this match as one of the league leaders. Daniele De Rossi's side has shown consistent results and will be looking to secure three points against an underdog. Cremonese, on the other hand, is in a desperate fight to stay in the top flight after their return to Serie A. However, the 'Tigers' pulled off a major upset in their last head-to-head meeting, defeating Roma in the Coppa Italia, which makes this clash particularly intriguing.

Team Form and Analysis

Cremonese

The 'Grigiorossi' rely on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. At home, with the support of their fans, Cremonese is capable of challenging any opponent. The team will be highly motivated to repeat their cup success and take points from Roma once again. In attack, all hopes are on the experience of veteran Franco Vázquez and top scorer Massimo Coda.

Roma

The 'Wolves' will be looking to avoid any slip-ups after their recent successes. The team boasts one of the strongest squads in the league, with Paulo Dybala and Romelu Lukaku shining in attack. Roma will aim to dominate from the first minutes and get revenge for the frustrating cup defeat. Some squad rotation is possible after the international break.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Team Form and Tactical Trends

Real Betis focuses this season on ball control and central play, where creative midfielders (Lo Celso/Fornals) dictate the tempo. At home, the team performs confidently, conceding on average less than 1 goal per game. However, against high-pressing teams like Girona, Betis' defense often struggles when playing out from the back. The key figure in attack is captain Mattia Zaccagni, through whom most combinations flow. Their vulnerability lies in central defense during rapid counter-attacks.

Lecce arrives in Rome with a clear mission: survive and sting. The Salentians typically operate in a 4-3-3 or 4-5-1 defensive shape, flooding the central zone. Their main strengths are the physical power of their defenders (led by Baschirotto) and quick transitions. Away from home, Lecce often keeps a clean sheet in the first half, aiming to exhaust the opponent and capitalize on errors late in the game.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history of this fixture is full of surprises. Lecce is a notoriously difficult opponent for Lazio. In the last 5 meetings, the Romans have secured only one convincing victory, while Lecce has beaten the Eagles twice and drawn twice. Statistics suggest that matches at the Olimpico often follow a 'Both Teams to Score' script, as the visitors know how to find their moments.

Getafe vs Atletico Madrid: Watch Live Stream Online - La Liga 23.11.2025

The Coliseum hosts one of La Liga's grittiest fixtures: the Madrid mini-derby between Getafe and Atlético Madrid. A clash between José Bordalás and Diego Simeone guarantees tactical warfare, intense physical battles, endless fouls, and minimal effective playing time. For the 'Colchoneros,' these are mandatory three points in the title race; for the hosts, it's a chance to drag a giant into their muddy style of play and steal points. The live stream on tutsport.net will reveal whose defensive philosophy stands stronger.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 23, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK).

Team Form and Tactical Analysis

Getafe remains true to its identity: the most aggressive and uncomfortable team in the league. The 'Blues' are masters of disrupting rhythm, utilizing tactical fouls, and turning any match into a brawl. At home, they concede very few goals, setting up a deep 5-4-1 or 4-4-2 defensive block. Their attack relies exclusively on set-pieces, long balls, and winning second balls. Against technical teams, this strategy works flawlessly, forcing opponents into frustration and errors.

Atlético Madrid attempts to hybridize its style this season: maintaining defensive solidity while adding creativity upfront through a mobile attacking unit. However, in away matches against low-block teams, 'Los Indios' often struggle with positional attacks. The key task for the visitors is to avoid falling for Getafe's provocations, avoid red cards, and convert what might be the single clear chance of the match. Physical fitness post-international break will be a decisive factor.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

For a long time, Atlético held absolute dominance over Getafe, going years without conceding a single goal against them. However, in recent seasons, this spell has broken: Getafe has learned to bite back, and high-scoring draws (like the famous 3-3) are no longer sensational. Nevertheless, over the long run, Atlético remains the favorite - the quality of the visitors' squad is significantly higher.

Getafe vs Atletico Madrid Prediction

Bookmakers favor the visitors, but the odds for a straight win are relatively high, reflecting the risks. Expect a low-scoring affair with a massive amount of physical struggle.

  • Main Bet: Atlético Double Chance and Under 2.5 Goals (X2 + TM 2.5). Do not expect a goal fest; the pitch will be a battlefield.
  • Statistics: Over 5.5 Yellow Cards. Bordalás vs Simeone guarantees roughness and arguments with the referee.
  • Correct Score (Risk): Atlético Win 1-0 or 0-0. One set-piece could decide the entire encounter.

Tune into the stream on tutsport.net and watch steel clash against steel in the Madrid derby.

The Giuseppe Meazza prepares for the pinnacle of Italian Calcio — the Derby della Madonnina. Inter hosts Milan in a match that could reshape the top of the Serie A table. The rivalry between Simone Inzaghi and the Rossoneri coaching staff enters a new phase: after Milan snapped their neighbors' hegemony last season, Inter's favorite status no longer looks unshakable. The live stream on tutsport.net will reveal whether the Nerazzurri can reclaim total dominance in the city.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 23, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK).

Team Form and Tactical Analysis

Inter remains the benchmark of stability in their 3-5-2 formation. The Lautaro Martinez — Marcus Thuram partnership continues to terrorize defenses through perfect understanding and physical power. The Nerazzurri dominate the midfield thanks to their central triangle, controlling the tempo. The hosts' only vulnerabilities are lapses in concentration during set-pieces and potential fatigue of the wing-backs during a congested schedule.

This season, Milan relies on aggressive, vertical football. Christian Pulisic and Rafael Leão are the main catalysts, creating danger through individual dribbling. However, the Rossoneri defense often looks disjointed: gaps between lines and positional errors are a chronic issue. The visitors can score against anyone, but clean sheets are extremely rare for them.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

For a long time, Inter mocked their neighbors, winning 6 derbies in a row (including a 5-1 rout). However, Milan's recent 2-1 victory showed that the psychological barrier has been broken. Now, this is a battle of equals, where Inter relies on system and structure, while Milan relies on chaos and flair. Trends point to high scoring: in the last 5 matches, the 'Both Teams to Score' bet landed 4 times.

Inter vs Milan Prediction

Despite Milan's recent localized success, Inter looks like the more complete structure ready for big matches. Expect an end-to-end game where the Rossoneri defense will eventually crack.

  • Value Bet: Inter Win and Both Teams to Score. The quality of the hosts' attack exceeds the quality of the visitors' defense.
